{{Recipe summary
| Category = Pudding recipes
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

The history of '''figgy pudding''' dates back to 16th century England.  The ancestor of figgy pudding (and plum pudding) is a medieval spiced porridge known as Frumenty. Today, the term ''figgy pudding'' is known mainly because of a popular Christmas carol. The carolers singing "We Wish You A Merry Christmas" mention it numerous times throughout the song. Currently figgy pudding is not very popular but is thought about during the holiday season.  It is a British-style pudding, or dessert, resembling something like a white Christmas pudding.  The pudding may be baked, steamed in the oven, boiled, or fried.

==Ingredients==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* ½ cup vegetable [[Cookbook:Shortening|shortening]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* 3 large [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolks]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] rum extract (or flavored extract of your choice)
* 2 [[Cookbook:Apple|apples]], peeled, cored, and finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] dried [[Cookbook:Fig|figs]], ground or finely chopped
* Grated peel of 1 [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] and 1 [[Cookbook:Orange|orange]]
* 1 cup chopped [[Cookbook:Nuts and Seeds|nuts]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* ¼ teaspoon ground [[Cookbook:Clove|cloves]]
* ¼ teaspoon ground [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]]
* 1 ½ cups dried [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|bread crumbs]]
* 2 teaspoons [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* 3 large [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg whites]], stiffly [[Cookbook:Whipping|whipped]]
* 1 strip of [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], finely crushed (optional; New England variant)
* 1 teaspoon of hard sauce, for drizzling

==Procedure==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 325 °F. Generously grease an oven-proof 2-[[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] bowl or mold; set aside.
# [[Cookbook:Creaming|Cream]] together butter and shortening. 
# Gradually add sugar, egg yolks, milk, extract, apple, figs, lemon and orange peel.
# Add next 6 ingredients, mixing well. [[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] whipped egg whites into mixture.
# Pour into prepared bowl or mold, place into large shallow pan, and place on middle rack in oven.
# Fill the shallow pan half-full with boiling water, and slowly steam pudding in oven at 325 °F for 4 hours, replacing water as needed.
